vedic_reference.note: Vaninath is a form of Shiva, who is also known as 'Vanaspati' or the lord of forests. He is invoked to protect the forests and preserve their natural beauty. In the Vedas, Vaninath is mentioned as the presiding deity of the 'Vana' or forest, and is worshipped to ensure the prosperity of the forest and its inhabitants.
